QF.id: Income, Residential Status, Five Heads of Income_17

question.text: Under section 80CCD(2), what is the maximum employer contribution to NPS that is deductible from the employee's income under the NEW tax regime?

answer.text: Employer NPS contribution is not deductible under the new regime

explanation.text: The Logic: Under section 80CCD(2), the deduction for employer contribution to NPS is capped at 10% of salary (Basic + DA) under the old tax regime and 14% of salary (Basic + DA) under the new tax regime. The new-regime limit is therefore higher than the old-regime limit for this specific deduction. The Trap: Candidates often memorize only the 10% figure or assume that the new regime disallows all deductions. The 80CCD(2) deduction continues to be available under the new regime, at the higher 14% limit. Note: The 14% / 10% limits are statutory ceilings on the deductible amount; the actual deduction is the lower of the employer's contribution and the applicable limit.
